description: Set the SAME Amazon product type field values (item_form, number_of_items, unit_count, package dimensions …) on an explicit list of up to 25 products — set_amazon_field_values for each product, with the same checks against the Amazon schema of THAT product's type, so a product whose type does not take a key is refused for that key only. When every product shares the value, set it once on their model or category with set_amazon_field_values instead. Keys, kinds and allowed values come from get_amazon_fields (read it for one of the products). Saved in the CRM only: a new listing carries the values; an existing offer is not changed. null removes a value. Idempotent. Returns one result per product (saved, or the refusal naming the fields); products are independent, so some can succeed while others fail. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: The Amazon store whose product type, language and allowed values to use (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Omit for the main store.

productIds.description: The products to write, at most 25 ids.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.

values.description: The fields to set or remove, by Amazon attribute key. A value replaces what this level held; null removes it, so the model's or the category's value shows through again.

key.description: The marketplace's attribute key (closure, department, number_of_compartments), or attribute.part for one part of an attribute made of several values (shirt_size.size_system) — get_amazon_fields lists them.

unit.description: For a measurement, the unit as the marketplace names it (liters, centimeters, kilograms) — one of the units get_amazon_fields lists for the field.

value.description: The value as a person writes it, in the marketplace's language: for a field with a list, one of its values or labels; a number as digits. null removes the value at this level.

name: set_amazon_field_values_for_products
title: Set Amazon field values on a list of products
